verdict.rationale: Motion supports creating multiple meeting templates with distinct durations, pre-meeting custom questions, and reminders, and offers embeddable booking pages for prospects, which covers much of the story's core (docs-7, docs-5, docs-27). However, there is no explicit evidence of per-event-type location settings or configurable confirmation rules (auto-confirm vs. manual approval) tied to specific event types. Missing for 10: explicit support for custom locations per event type, and documented confirmation/approval rule configuration.
